_what: Paths the security scanner (scripts/scan.mjs in the security-review skill) treats as NOT SOURCE. This is a decision, not a suppression: the scan still reports everything it finds in these paths' neighbours, and declaring hand-written code here is itself a finding. Every entry needs a reason.
_why_this_file_is_here: data/nbi_cache/ used to fall out of the scan by accident — one file (TX23.txt, 22MB) crossed the scanner's 20MB per-file cap, so the scan reported an honest blind spot, and the blind spot disabled the high-severity client.api-link check. An accidental size-based drop is indistinguishable from a file nobody looked at. Saying out loud what the directory holds fixes the cause instead of the symptom.

ignore.reason: Generated FHWA National Bridge Inventory cache — 52 fixed-width/CSV state extracts, 244MB, re-downloadable with scripts/nbi_import.py --download-only --all-states. Gitignored, never deployed (netlify.toml prunes data/ at build), and contains no code, credentials or app logic — it is public federal bridge data keyed by structure number.
